[S266AC272BB] Webhooks — Webhooks > Delivery
# Webhooks

## Delivery
Lumen sends webhook events as HTTP POST requests with a JSON body. Failed deliveries are retried with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours.

[S91FBEFD3BA] Authentication — Authentication > Request ids
## Request ids
Send an `X-Request-Id` header to correlate client logs with server traces; the server generates one if it is missing.

[S23FEBE6082] Postmortem: GPU Memory Exhaustion During Traffic Spike — Postmortem: GPU Memory Exhaustion During Traffic Spike > Root cause
## Root cause
Continuous batching admitted too many long sequences; `max_num_seqs` had been raised without a load test, so the KV cache did not fit in accelerator memory.

[SC133CD426E] RetryPolicy Configuration — RetryPolicy Configuration > Jitter
## Jitter
Full jitter is enabled by default to avoid synchronized retries from many clients.

[S69387CC30B] Idempotency Keys — Idempotency Keys > Purpose
# Idempotency Keys

## Purpose
Send an `Idempotency-Key` header on POST requests so that retrying a request after a network failure does not create a second payment, job or resource.

[S43BF09212C] Load Shedding and Rate Limiting — Load Shedding and Rate Limiting > Client guidance
## Client guidance
Clients must back off exponentially and respect Retry-After instead of retrying immediately.

[S69C5F3B428] On-Call Handbook — On-Call Handbook > Rotation
# On-Call Handbook

## Rotation
Each team runs a weekly on-call rotation with a primary and a secondary engineer. Handoff happens every Monday at 10:00 with a short review of open alerts.
